title: Glowing island with a palm tree
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- water -->
  <rect x="0" y="62" width="100" height="38" rx="4" fill="#1a3a6a"/>
  <!-- water highlights -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="72" rx="10" ry="2" fill="#2a5aaa"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="78" rx="12" ry="2" fill="#2a5aaa"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="85" rx="8" ry="1.5" fill="#2a5aaa"/>
  <!-- island sand -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="30" ry="12" fill="#e8c860"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="28" ry="10" fill="#f0d878"/>
  <!-- sand shading -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="26" ry="6" fill="#d8b048"/>
  <!-- palm trunk -->
  <path d="M48 60 Q44 45 46 32 Q47 26 48 22 L52 22 Q53 26 54 32 Q56 45 53 60 Z" fill="#a06020"/>
  <path d="M50 60 Q47 45 48 32 Q49 26 50 22 L52 22 Q53 26 54 32 Q56 45 53 60 Z" fill="#c07830" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- trunk rings -->
  <path d="M47 50 Q50 48 53 50" stroke="#d09040" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M47 42 Q50 40 53.5 42" stroke="#d09040" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M48 34 Q50 32 53 34" stroke="#d09040" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  <!-- palm leaves -->
  <path d="M50 22 Q30 14 18 24 Q28 20 36 24 Q44 28 50 22 Z" fill="#30c060"/>
  <path d="M50 22 Q68 10 84 20 Q72 16 64 22 Q56 28 50 22 Z" fill="#40d070"/>
  <path d="M50 22 Q24 22 16 36 Q28 26 38 28 Q46 28 50 22 Z" fill="#28b058"/>
  <path d="M50 22 Q76 22 86 38 Q74 28 62 28 Q54 28 50 22 Z" fill="#38c868"/>
  <path d="M50 22 Q42 10 50 4 Q54 12 50 22 Z" fill="#50e080"/>
  <path d="M50 22 Q58 12 62 18 Q56 20 50 22 Z" fill="#48d878"/>
  <!-- coconuts -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="24" r="3" fill="#b08030"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="25" r="2.5" fill="#a07028"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="21" r="2.5" fill="#c09038"/>
  <!-- palm leaf glow highlights -->
  <path d="M50 22 Q32 15 20 24" stroke="#80ffb0" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M50 22 Q66 12 82 20" stroke="#80ffb0" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- glow around trunk top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="10" fill="#50e080" opacity="0.15"/>
  <!-- sun -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="18" r="8" fill="#ffdd44"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="18" r="6" fill="#ffee88"/>
  <!-- sun rays -->
  <line x1="82" y1="6" x2="82" y2="3" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="92" y1="12" x2="95" y2="10" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="12" x2="69" y2="10" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="92" y1="24" x2="95" y2="26" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="26" x2="70" y2="28" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- small cloud -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="14" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#3a5a9a"/>
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="13" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#3a5a9a"/>
  <ellipse cx="15" cy="13" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#3a5a9a"/>
</svg>
